audit: f290 Human creation sidecar-preservation failure and already-published minimal owner fix

human_creation.observed: Main store.db and unrelated-resource.bin preserved; store.db-wal, store.db-shm and store.db-journal disappeared.
human_creation.oracle: Sorted names and exact bytes for every file in retained directory, on initial refusal and planned retry/reopen.
human_creation.later_variants: schema and data-page-delete-mode were not reached after first-variant panic.

log_metadata.format: Complete connector-decoded job log, UTF-8 exact text

root_cause.old_branch: probe_human_conversation_store returns Ok on any nonempty -wal or -journal before inspecting the main database.
root_cause.effect: open_human_conversation_store then calls existing SQLite open/journal_mode/schema path. SQLite removed the synthetic invalid sidecars before NOTADB failure even with recover_on_corruption=false. The app must prevent this delegation when raw main bytes already prove NOTADB.
root_cause.classification_basis: NMR-CREATE-01d explicitly requires preserving original database and sidecar bytes on refusal. Artificial invalid sidecar files exercise that defined negative contract. Deleting the assertion or weakening the saved-directory comparison would hide the observed destructive effect.

observed_fix.change: Read first 16 bytes of nonempty existing main file through std::fs::File before sidecar bypass or any SQLite handle. Reject short header via read_exact error and non-SQLite magic via Integrity. Missing/zero-length database and valid-header WAL/rollback delegation retain existing behavior.

caller.order: open_human_conversation_store resolves path, executes probe with ?, and only then calls open_with_options_and_seed -> open_configured_db. No owner handle is published before successful open.

observed_fix.static_assessment: Covers the observed NOTADB + invalid sidecar loss before any SQLite action; exact-H execution remains pending.

newer_observation.change: Adds short-header to the same existing case while retaining NOTADB/schema/data-page variants and every original no-loss/retry/reopen assertion.
newer_observation.qualification: A pass at 9b9 does not execute this later short-header variant even though both suite counts remain 12.

spec.scope: Human creation must refuse corruption without quarantine/reset/salvage; database and sidecars remain byte-identical. Arbitrary hot/corrupt-sidecar recovery remains explicitly open.
